content_sections.heading: BHEL Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: BHEL has announced a common application schedule for Engineer/Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee recruitment. The dates are tentative and may be revised through the official website. Important: Candidates should complete their applications and applicable fee payments before 11:45 PM on 28 December 2026. Any changes to the examination schedule will be published on the BHEL Careers website.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Vacancy 2026 - 415 Engineer, Executive and Supervisor Trainee Posts
content_sections.text: BHEL has advertised 200 Engineer/Executive Trainee vacancies and 215 Supervisor Trainee vacancies. These vacancies are tentative and may change according to manpower requirements. Note: BHEL has also earmarked eight PwBD vacancies within the advertised Engineer/Executive Trainee vacancies. These are horizontal reservations and are not additional posts. The Executive Trainee (HR) recruitment also covers the requirement for Welfare Officer positions across BHEL units. The Supervisor Trainee notification additionally identifies 12 PwBD and 29 Ex-Servicemen reservations within the advertised recruitment. These should not be added to the total vacancies.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualifications differ between Engineer/Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee recruitment. Candidates must possess the prescribed full-time qualifications in the respective disciplines. Candidates must possess both of the following qualifications: A full-time regular Bachelor's Degree from a recognized Indian university with at least 60% aggregate marks. A two-year full-time regular postgraduate Degree or Diploma in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, Social Work or an MBA, with at least 55% aggregate marks. Candidates with postgraduate qualifications in Social Work or Business Administration must have studied Personnel Management, Labour Welfare or HRM as a specialization or elective in their final year. Candidates must be qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) or Cost and Management Accountants (CMA) from institutions recognized by the appropriate statutory authorities in India. A B.Com. degree alone does not satisfy the eligibility requirements for Executive Trainee (Finance). Important: The lower qualifying percentage for SC/ST candidates applies according to the reservation conditions. SC/ST candidates competing against unreserved posts cannot automatically claim the relaxed qualification percentage. Yes. Eligible candidates with a full-time regular Engineering Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics or Civil Engineering can apply for the corresponding Supervisor Trainee positions. However, the Engineering Diploma alone is not sufficient for the Engineer Trainee posts, which require an eligible Engineering Degree. Yes. The notifications permit candidates in the final year or semester of their qualifying course to apply. However, shortlisted candidates must provide proof of having passed the required examination by the document verification stage. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed certificates or marksheets by that stage will be disqualified.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or other methods supported by the recruitment payment gateway. The fee is non-refundable. Additional bank transaction charges may apply depending on the chosen payment method.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is different for Engineer/Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee posts. Selection includes a Computer-Based Examination and interview. Online application and eligibility scrutiny. Computer-Based Examination (CBE). Shortlisting for interview in a 1:5 ratio, based on vacancies, discipline and reservation category. Personal interview. Verification of documents and eligibility. Final merit preparation and medical fitness assessment. Supervisor Trainees will undergo a two-stage selection procedure: Computer-Based Examination (CBE). Document Verification / Scrutiny for shortlisted candidates. Candidates will be shortlisted for document verification in the ratio of 1:3 based on their CBE performance, discipline, vacancies and reservation category. Document verification is a qualifying stage. The final merit list will be based entirely on the CBE score of candidates found eligible during verification. Important: Meeting the minimum qualifying percentage does not guarantee shortlisting. Actual interview or document verification cut-offs depend on merit and the number of vacancies.

content_sections.text: BHEL has tentatively scheduled the Computer-Based Examination for 27 January 2027 . The examination for the same discipline in Engineer/Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee recruitment will be held on the same day.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Engineer and Supervisor Trainee Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Both recruitment categories provide one year of training, followed by absorption into the corresponding BHEL position upon successful completion. Employees may also receive Dearness Allowance, perks, HRA or company accommodation, medical facilities, Provident Fund, gratuity and other benefits under the applicable company rules. Salary Clarification: Annual CTC is an approximate employer cost and should not be interpreted as guaranteed annual take-home salary.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Recruitment 2026 Service Bond
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must execute a service agreement before joining the training programme. Important: The service bond lasts three years excluding the one-year training period. Candidates must also submit the prescribed stamped indemnity bond with a suitable surety.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Recruitment 2026 Posting and Transfer Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be posted to BHEL manufacturing units, Power Sector regions, project sites or other notified establishments according to vacancies and recruitment requirements. Applicants must indicate their preferred units or sites while filling out the application. Final allocation will depend on merit, preferences, reservation norms and vacancy availability. Important Posting Condition: Selected candidates are required to serve at their allotted unit or site for at least 10 years from the date of joining . Requests for transfer or change of posting will generally not be entertained during this period.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official BHEL Careers portal. Apply Online: careers.bhel.in Registration Opening: 25 November 2026, 10:00 AM. Registration Closing: 28 December 2026, 11:45 PM. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BHEL Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates should select the examination discipline and trainee position carefully. Applications containing incorrect category, qualification or identity details may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BHEL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the following documents ready as applicable: Class 10 certificate for proof of date of birth. Relevant Engineering Degree or Diploma certificates and marksheets. Qualifying Bachelor's Degree certificates for HR and Finance Supervisor Trainee posts. Relevant postgraduate Degree or Diploma certificates for Executive Trainee (HR). CA or CMA qualification records for Executive Trainee (Finance). Semester-wise marksheets and CGPA conversion proof, where applicable. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, where applicable. PwBD certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable. Valid photo identification. Recent photograph and scanned signature in the required format. No Objection Certificate, where applicable. Online application confirmation. Application and processing fee receipt. Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents during verification. Candidates employed in Government departments, autonomous organizations or PSUs may be required to provide an NOC from their employer.
